items.title: Report: Broncos to put Pat Bryant on injured reserve
items.text: Broncos head coach Sean Payton said on Wednesday that he didn't think wide receiver Pat Bryant would be placed on injured reserve, but it appears something has changed about Denver's view of the wideout's ankle injury.
